g.text: One beta step, end to end: `(lam x. x, lam a. lam b. a)` reduces to `lam a. lam b. a`
Please use CSS style instead of skinparam ParticipantPadding
`(lam x. x, lam a. lam b. a)`
`(lam x. x, lam a. lam b. a)`
(binder AND body, not the opened body)
RHS `(eval fun arg)` is the two-argument form
walk the body, replacing bound occurrences of `x` by `arg`
body is exactly the bound occurrence -> result is `arg`
no `App` node remains -> no rule matches ->
Printed by display.rs as `lam a . lam b . a` — the K combinator.
`Beta` has an EMPTY premise list (`Beta . |- ...`), so it fires on
SHAPE ALONE. The three congruence rules carry a `S ~> T` premise
and are what license firing at a NON-ROOT position.
